svg.text: Apex Solutions Pvt. Ltd. | March 2026 | CONFIDENTIAL | Threat → Impact → Mitigation
| Risk Score = Likelihood × Impact | 18 findings across 4 severity levels
Block at perimeter firewall; enforce VPN-only RDP;
Disable SMBv1 on all Windows systems;
enforce SMB signing; patch all hosts
enforce SSH v2 with key-based auth only
No MFA on VPN / Remote Access
Single-factor auth exposed to brute force
Deploy TOTP/FIDO2 MFA for all remote access;
Former employees; attack surface for credential abuse
Flat LAN — No East-West Traffic Controls
Unrestricted lateral movement once inside perimeter
enforce firewall ACLs between all segments
from firewall, AD, endpoints, and web servers
No certificate-based auth; shared password risk
Rogue APs and evil twin attacks undetected
Enable WIPS on wireless LAN controller;
deploy dedicated rogue AP detection sensors
Vulnerable to POODLE, BEAST, and downgrade attacks
block public access at perimeter firewall
Insufficient for incident forensics or breach investigation
Extend to 90+ days hot, 1 year cold archive;
use compressed cold storage for cost efficiency
No inspection of inbound exploits or east-west movement
Deploy Suricata/Snort IDS at edge and core;
Guest-to-guest and limited guest-to-internal routing possible
Enable AP client isolation on guest SSID;
review and tighten guest VLAN firewall rules
HTTP Not Fully Redirected to HTTPS
Some pages reachable over cleartext HTTP
Privileged Accounts Used for Daily Tasks
Domain Admin used on workstations; blast radius risk
| Overall Risk Rating: HIGH | Immediate action required on rows 1–3
Prioritize: RDP block → SMBv1 disable → Telnet disable → MFA rollout → SIEM deployment | Target: all Critical resolved within 48 hours
Likelihood: Very High = near certain | High = probable | Medium = possible | Low = unlikely
Impact: Critical = business-ending / data breach | High = major disruption | Medium = significant | Low = minor
Apex Solutions Network Security Assessment | March 2026 | CONFIDENTIAL — For internal use only
